cat > checkconf.py <<'EOF'
KNOWN_KEYS = {'name', 'port', 'debug'}


def main(argv):
    with open(argv[0]) as settings:
        lines = settings.read().splitlines()
    status = 0
    for line in lines:
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        key = line.partition('=')[0].strip()
        if key not in KNOWN_KEYS:
            print(f'unknown key: {key}')
            status = 1
    return status
EOF
cat >> tests/test_checkconf.py <<'EOF'


def run(tmp_path, text):
    settings = tmp_path / 'service.conf'
    settings.write_text(text)
    return main([str(settings)])


def test_main_returns_1_for_an_unknown_key(tmp_path):
    assert run(tmp_path, 'name = web\ncolour = red\n') == 1


def test_main_returns_0_and_prints_nothing_for_known_keys(tmp_path, capsys):
    assert run(tmp_path, 'name = web\nport = 80\ndebug = true\n') == 0
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == ''


def test_main_returns_0_for_an_empty_file(tmp_path, capsys):
    assert run(tmp_path, '') == 0
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == ''


def test_main_reports_every_unknown_key_in_order(tmp_path, capsys):
    assert run(tmp_path, 'colour = red\nname = web\nsize = 3\n') == 1
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == 'unknown key: colour\nunknown key: size\n'


def test_main_reports_a_repeated_unknown_key_each_time(tmp_path, capsys):
    run(tmp_path, 'colour = red\ncolour = blue\n')
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == 'unknown key: colour\nunknown key: colour\n'


def test_main_reports_an_unknown_key_on_the_last_line_without_newline(tmp_path, capsys):
    assert run(tmp_path, 'name = web\ncolour = red') == 1
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == 'unknown key: colour\n'


def test_main_reports_the_key_only_when_the_value_contains_equals(tmp_path, capsys):
    run(tmp_path, 'colour = a=b\n')
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == 'unknown key: colour\n'


def test_main_matches_known_keys_exactly(tmp_path, capsys):
    run(tmp_path, 'names = x\nPort = 1\n')
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == 'unknown key: names\nunknown key: Port\n'
EOF
